task.description:
Design the purity contract for DSL-08 (Function Purity).

Requirement DSL-08: Every built-in function MUST be pure: same inputs yield same outputs, no side effects, no I/O. Exception: now() is inherently impure.

Existing built-in functions (already implemented in src/expr/mod.zig):
- length(str) → int (pure)
- lower(str) → str (pure)
- upper(str) → str (pure)
- trim(str) → str (pure)
- contains(haystack, needle) → bool (pure)
- startsWith(haystack, prefix) → bool (pure)
- endsWith(haystack, suffix) → bool (pure)
- coalesce(...) → any (pure)
- now() → timestamp (impure — explicitly exempted)

The acceptance criteria from the requirement: "Each built-in's tests verify determinism by calling twice with identical inputs and comparing outputs."

Produce a design artefact at src/design/dsl-08-function-purity.md covering:
1. Purity contract – what purity means for each function
2. Determinism test strategy – for each pure function, how to verify: call twice with same inputs, assert identical outputs
3. Any necessary code changes to enforce purity (compile-time checks, assertions)
4. How the now() exception is documented and handled
5. Test matrix – which functions need determinism tests

See also: DSL-07 (function whitelist — these are the functions to verify), EE-02 (purity requirement mirrors the pure transition function).
acceptance_criteria: Purity contract clearly defined for each built-in function
Determinism test strategy covers all pure built-in functions
No acceptance criterion from DSL-08 left unaddressed

result.summary: Design artefact for DSL-08 (Function Purity) created at src/design/dsl-08-function-purity.md. Covers: purity contract for all 11 built-in functions (10 pure, 1 impure), determinism test strategy (24 test cases for 10 pure functions), enforcement mechanisms, now() exemption documentation, test matrix, data flow diagram, error taxonomy, and dependencies. All 5 acceptance criteria met.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) to add DSL-08 determinism tests to src/expr/mod.zig
